_note: Custom descriptions for system tools (plan L208: language_detection with a custom description; risk 2 at L234). WP8/provisioning copies them into the agent config.
language_detection: Switch the conversation between Latvian (lv) and Russian (ru). Call it ONLY when the caller speaks a complete sentence in the other language, or explicitly asks to switch (e.g. 'Можно по-русски?', 'Runāsim latviski'). Call it BEFORE your first word in the new language, in both directions (Latvian to Russian and Russian to Latvian); going back to Latvian, the default, also needs this call with lv. Never answer in another language without this call. A Russian sentence in reply to the bilingual opening counts. Do NOT call it for Latvian street, district or company names inside Russian speech (e.g. 'Ilūkstes iela шестнадцать', 'Rīgas namu pārvaldnieks'), for single words such as 'labi', 'paldies', 'да', for numbers, or for an address dictated in Latvian form. If unsure, stay in the current language.
end_call: End the call after the caller has said goodbye and you have said the closing line, or after a booking or callback is confirmed and the caller has nothing more to ask.
